entry.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
entry.summary: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.

entry.title: Todoist confirms 6% of customers’ details were stolen in data breach
entry.summary: Todoist said a hacker gained access to its production systems and stole customer data, including email IDs, password hashes, and account creation dates.

entry.title: Allstate suffers multiday tech outage ahead of Thanksgiving
entry.summary: The disruption comes at a particularly bad time for the insurance giant, as millions of Americans prepare to travel for the Thanksgiving holiday weekend.

entry.title: WhatsApp now lets you schedule messages in group and individual chats
entry.summary: Users can schedule messages from 10 minutes later to after 14 days.

entry.title: X’s latest update for creators focuses on vertical video
entry.summary: As short-form video ramps up in popularity, X's new creation tools are part of its effort to compete with YouTube and Instagram.

entry.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
entry.summary: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.

entry.title: DOJ accuses former cyber executive of defrauding ransomware victims by secretly paying hackers
entry.summary: U.S. prosecutors accused the former executive of defrauding victims of ransomware by paying the hackers, charging victims more, and pocketing the difference.

entry.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
entry.summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

entry.title: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe
entry.summary: The password manager maker said an attacker gained access to an employee's corporate account and took some information about customers.

entry.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
entry.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

entry.title: The canceled Tesla Cybertruck is the fastest-selling used truck in America
entry.summary: The Tesla Cybertruck was the fastest-selling used truck last month, averaging just 39.1 days on the market compared to 65.5 days for trucks overall.

entry.title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
entry.summary: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.

entry.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
entry.summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.

entry.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
entry.summary: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.

entry.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
entry.summary: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest rating.

entry.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
entry.summary: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.

entry.title: A month with the iPhone Duo has changed how I use my phone
entry.summary: From reading more books to breaking mindless scrolling habits, Apple's foldable has changed my daily routines in ways I didn't anticipate.

entry.title: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years
entry.summary: Elon Musk's social network X has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see on the platform.

entry.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?
entry.summary: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.

entry.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
entry.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
